41 Westhill Drive (Z-26-02)
Changes to the Zoning Bylaw for this location are required before a permit can be issued. This means that they submit an application that is reviewed by city planners and other agencies plus city council before anything can be built.
The Regional Municipality of Waterloo is proposing to develop a new 6 storey mixed-income apartment building at 41 Westhill Drive. The Region of Waterloo will not construct, own or manage the ultimate development on this site, but intends to issue a future Request for Proposal (RFP) for an industry partner to develop the site requiring 30% of the units as affordable housing.
Zoning Bylaw changes requested include:
change the zoning from Residential Nine (R9) to Residential Mixed-Use 20 (RMU-20)
reducing the minimum rear yard setback from 7.5 metres to 5.0 metres
reducing the required vehicular parking (residential) from 0.8 spaces/unit to 0.75 spaces/unit
reducing the maximum proportion of the front building façade located within 7.5 metres of the street line from 75% to 25%.
A Holding (H) symbol for adequate municipal servicing (sanitary and water)
View the documents submitted by the development company under supporting documents on this page for more details and drawings.
Building height, units, housing types
Building Height: 6 storeys (20 metres)
Number of units: 56
Unit sizes: mix of one and two bedrooms
Housing types: apartments
Parking
Parking: 48 [include if above or underground or primarily underground]
Bicycle parking: 34
